library.description: Framed character image surface showing a figure; optional animated/glitch state flag. Content (image source) is supplied at runtime.
Horizontal filled bar showing value within 0..max; fill fraction is value/max clamped to 0-1. Optional segmentation renders the bar as discrete cells, optional numeric overlay shows value/max.
Strip of active status-effect indicators; each effect has an id, label, optional kind and optional remaining duration in seconds. Emits the effect id when one is picked.

props.effects: { id: string; label: string; kind?: 'buff' | 'debuff' | 'neutral'; remaining?: number }[]

library.description: Compact numeric rank/level indicator; displays an integer level with an optional short rank caption supplied as data.
Numeric value display; when animate is set the displayed number tweens from the previous value to the new one. Unit/prefix strings are data supplied at runtime.

Scrollable list of multi-field records (label plus optional detail text, numeric/text value and availability status); one record can be selected, emitting its id. onActivate fires for a separate confirm/open action.

props.options: { id: string; label: string; detail?: string; value?: string | number; status?: 'available' | 'locked' | 'active' }[]

library.description: List of collapsible entries, each with a title, optional subtitle and nested objective and reward data; one entry may be expanded and one marked active/highlighted. Emits ids on expand and select.

props.entries: { id: string; title: string; subtitle?: string; objectives?: { id: string; label: string; done: boolean }[]; rewards?: { label: string; value: string | number }[] }[]

library.description: Vertical checklist of objectives, each with a done flag and optional optional-marker; emits the objective id when an item is toggled.

props.items: { id: string; label: string; done: boolean; optional?: boolean }[]

library.description: Read-only list of label/value stat lines with optional signed delta styling; can render inline or as a floating tooltip when visible is controlled.

props.items: { label: string; value: string | number; delta?: number }[]

library.description: Momentary push button; fires onPress on activation. Face content is supplied via children.
Latching two-state button; emits the new boolean state on activation. Face content is supplied via children.
Single equipment socket showing its occupying item (name, rarity tier, optional icon and stat summary) or an empty state; selectable and clearable, emitting its slot id.

props.item?: { id: string; name: string; rarity?: 'common' | 'uncommon' | 'rare' | 'epic' | 'legendary'; iconSrc?: string; stat?: string | number }

library.description: Single cyberware socket placed either in a grid or on a body surface at normalized 0-1 coordinates; shows its installed implant, empty, or locked state and emits its id on selection.

props.implant?: { id: string; name: string; tier?: string | number }

library.description: Anatomical body-diagram surface in normalized 0-1 coordinates; holds ImplantSlot elements positioned by their own x/y props.
Pannable/zoomable map surface using normalized 0-1 world coordinates; holds MapMarker and MapRoute elements placed by their own coordinate props. Emits view changes as center plus zoom factor.

props.onViewChange: (view: { center: { x: number; y: number }; zoom: number }) => void

library.description: Point marker drawn on a map surface at normalized 0-1 coordinates; kind distinguishes quest/POI/player/waypoint forms, emits its id when clicked.
Polyline path drawn on a map surface through a sequence of normalized 0-1 points, optionally animated as a flowing route.
Cluster of zoom in/out and recenter controls; emits the requested zoom factor within min..max and pan deltas in normalized 0-1 units.
Read-only key listing marker/symbol kinds with their meanings.

props.items: { id: string; label: string; kind?: string }[]

library.description: Horizontal segmented tab control; one option selected at a time, emits the option id.

props.options: { id: string; label: string; count?: number }[]
